title: AI Native Film Studio F0 Source Feasibility
question: Does modifying official Blender source create enough reliable film-native control to justify the ownership, merge and distribution cost of a thin fork?

gates.name: Reproducible source build
acceptance: Two clean builds from the pinned source on the admitted host exit successfully
Both binaries report Blender 5.2.0 and the pinned source identity
Binary bundles are semantically identical; any byte difference is localized and explained
Receipt records source, dependencies, toolchain, commands, wall time, peak memory and disk delta
A deliberate one-byte-below disk admission case launches no compiler or Blender process
negativeControls: disk free bytes below admission threshold
source HEAD differs from pinned commit

gates.name: Independent product identity
acceptance: User-visible product name is Film Studio Engine F0 and does not present Blender as the product brand
macOS bundle identifier is studio.ainativefilm.f0
Icon and splash are project-owned placeholders with recorded provenance
Configuration root is isolated from official Blender
Launching and resetting the F0 app does not mutate official Blender preferences
negativeControls: official Blender configuration hash before and after F0 launch

gates.name: Minimum film workspace
acceptance: A native start surface exposes Project, Scene, Shot and Character objects
A user can create and select one shot without navigating the generic DCC layout
Expert Mode exposes the complete Blender workspace without data conversion
Workspace state survives save, quit and reopen
At least one task requires fewer interactions than the frozen official-Blender baseline
negativeControls: reopen with missing optional workspace state
switch to Expert Mode and back

gates.name: Embedded typed contract
acceptance: The product accepts the frozen SceneSpec fixture without arbitrary generated Python
Embedded and external compilers produce canonical-exact BuildPlan bytes
B01 and B02 fixtures build successfully in isolated clean roots
Invalid schema, semantic and path fixtures are rejected before scene mutation
Proposal diff and approval scope are visible before execution

gates.name: Headless render and receipts
acceptance: One approved job produces EEVEE preview and Cycles multilayer EXR without mouse input
Decoded pixel and pass semantics are independently audited
Process, timing, peak memory, disk and output identities are cross-bound
An interrupted stage resumes only from verified immutable receipts
A rejected admission launches no native renderer

gates.name: Pinned upstream merge drill
acceptance: Merge target and test corpus are frozen before the merge begins
No more than 10 source paths require manual conflict resolution
Manual conflict resolution takes no more than 8 person-hours
Fork-owned source patch is no more than 5000 non-generated changed lines
All F0.1-F0.5 conformance fixtures retain their prior verdicts
gates.fallbackTrigger: Any numeric ceiling is exceeded or a core patch cannot be isolated without weakening a frozen contract

gates.name: macOS package and round trip
acceptance: Unsigned research package installs and uninstalls without touching official Blender
Signing and notarization commands, credentials boundary and expected cost are documented
One official-Blender `.blend` file opens and re-saves without semantic regression
One F0-created `.blend` file opens in official Blender with declared graceful degradation
Preferences and caches remain in the independent configuration namespace

programDecision.thinFork: Adopt only if all seven gates pass and no fallback trigger fires
programDecision.externalShell: Recommend if F0.6 or F0.7 exceeds its ceiling, or source changes add no measured control/UX advantage
programDecision.inconclusive: Keep status BLOCKED when required external authority or hardware is absent; do not relabel as PASS
